```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

ua = httr::user_agent("ISA401StudentProject/1.0 (Educational R Scraper)")

read_wiki = function(url) {
  res = httr::GET(url, ua)
  httr::stop_for_status(res)
  rvest::read_html(res)
}

base = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing_with_the_Stars_(American_TV_series)_season_"
seasons = 1:35

cast_pages = vector("list", length(seasons))
week_pages = vector("list", length(seasons))

for (i in seq_along(seasons)) {
  
  season_url = paste0(base, seasons[i])
  pg = read_wiki(season_url)
  
  page_year = stringr::str_extract(
    pg |> rvest::html_element("table.infobox") |> rvest::html_text(),
    "20\\d{2}"
  )
  
  all_tables = pg |> rvest::html_table(fill = TRUE)
  all_tables = lapply(all_tables, function(t) {
    names(t) = make.names(names(t), unique = TRUE)
    return(t)
  })
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Casts Table (Matches any table with Celebrity/Contestant AND Partner/Status/Notability)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cast_idx = which(sapply(all_tables, function(t) {
    has_celeb  = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("celebrity|contestant", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_role   = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("notability|known|occupation|partner", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_status = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("status|result|place", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    # Exclude weekly scoring tables (which have a "Dance" or "Score" column)
    not_weekly = !any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("dance|score", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_celeb && has_role && has_status && not_weekly
  }))[1]
  
  if (!is.na(cast_idx)) {
    raw_cast = all_tables[[cast_idx]]
    
    celeb_col  = names(raw_cast)[stringr::str_detect(names(raw_cast), stringr::regex("celebrity|contestant", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
    role_col   = names(raw_cast)[stringr::str_detect(names(raw_cast), stringr::regex("notability|known|occupation", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
    status_col = names(raw_cast)[stringr::str_detect(names(raw_cast), stringr::regex("status|result|place", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
    
    names(raw_cast)[names(raw_cast) == celeb_col] = "Celebrity"
    if (!is.na(role_col)) {
      names(raw_cast)[names(raw_cast) == role_col] = "Notability"
    } else {
      raw_cast$Notability = NA_character_
    }
    if (!is.na(status_col)) names(raw_cast)[names(raw_cast) == status_col] = "Status"
    
    cast_pages[[i]] = raw_cast |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        season    = as.character(seasons[i]),
        page_year = page_year,
        dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character),
        Celebrity = stringr::str_remove_all(Celebrity, "\\[.*?\\]") |> stringr::str_trim()
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Celebrity), Celebrity != "", !stringr::str_detect(Celebrity, stringr::regex("^celebrity$|^contestant$", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("Celebrity", "Notability", "Status", "season", "page_year")))
  } else {
    message(sprintf("Warning: No Cast table matched on Season %d", seasons[i]))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Weekly Tables (Substring match handles merged multi-row headers in S29-S34)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  week_idx = which(sapply(all_tables, function(t) {
    has_couple = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("couple|contestant|pair", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_dance  = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("dance|style", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_score  = any(stringr::str_detect(names(t), stringr::regex("score", ignore_case = TRUE)))
    has_couple && has_dance && has_score
  }))
  
  if (length(week_idx) > 0) {
    season_weeks = vector("list", length(week_idx))
    
    for (w in seq_along(week_idx)) {
      tbl = all_tables[[week_idx[w]]] |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          season         = as.character(seasons[i]),
          week_table_num = as.character(w),
          dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character)
        )
      
      # When Wikipedia has a 2-row header (e.g., "Judge's scores" spanning 3 columns),
      # html_table() splits scores across multiple columns ("Judge.s.scores", "Judge.s.scores.1", etc.)
      couple_col = names(tbl)[stringr::str_detect(names(tbl), stringr::regex("couple|contestant|pair", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
      dance_col  = names(tbl)[stringr::str_detect(names(tbl), stringr::regex("dance|style", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
      result_col = names(tbl)[stringr::str_detect(names(tbl), stringr::regex("result|status", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
      score_cols = names(tbl)[stringr::str_detect(names(tbl), stringr::regex("score", ignore_case = TRUE))]
      
      if (!is.na(couple_col)) names(tbl)[names(tbl) == couple_col] = "Couple"
      if (!is.na(dance_col))  names(tbl)[names(tbl) == dance_col]  = "Dance"
      if (!is.na(result_col)) names(tbl)[names(tbl) == result_col] = "Result"
      
      # Combine multiple judge score columns into a single "Scores" string if split across columns
      if (length(score_cols) > 1) {
        tbl$Scores = apply(tbl[, score_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) paste(na.omit(r[r != ""]), collapse = ", "))
      } else if (length(score_cols) == 1) {
        names(tbl)[names(tbl) == score_cols[1]] = "Scores"
      }
      
      if ("Scores" %in% names(tbl)) {
        season_weeks[[w]] = tbl |>
          dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("Couple", "Scores", "Dance", "Result", "season", "week_table_num"))) |>
          dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(Scores),
            stringr::str_trim(Scores) != "",
            !stringr::str_detect(Couple, stringr::regex("^couple$|^contestant$|no\\s*scores?\\s*received", ignore_case = TRUE)),
            !stringr::str_detect(Scores, stringr::regex("score|no\\s*scores?\\s*received|n/a", ignore_case = TRUE))
          ) |>
          tidyr::separate(
            col   = Couple,
            into  = c("celebrity_name_short", "pro_name_short"),
            sep   = "\\s*&\\s*|\\s+and\\s+",
            extra = "merge",
            fill  = "right"
          ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            celebrity_name_short = stringr::str_remove_all(celebrity_name_short, "\\[.*?\\]") |> stringr::str_trim(),
            pro_name_short       = stringr::str_remove_all(pro_name_short, "\\[.*?\\]") |> stringr::str_trim()
          )
      }
    }
    week_pages[[i]] = dplyr::bind_rows(season_weeks)
  } else {
    message(sprintf("Warning: No Weekly tables matched on Season %d", seasons[i]))
  }
  
  Sys.sleep(0.3)
}

dwts_casts_raw = dplyr::bind_rows(cast_pages)
dwts_weekly    = dplyr::bind_rows(week_pages)

cat("Casts seasons captured:", length(unique(dwts_casts_raw$season)), "of 35\n")
cat("Weekly seasons captured:", length(unique(dwts_weekly$season)), "of 35\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Look Up Each Celebrity's Birth Date (<span class="bday">) Directly by Name
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_birth_date_by_name = function(celeb_name, idx, total) {
  if (idx %% 25 == 0) message(sprintf("Fetching birth date %d of %d (%s)...", idx, total, celeb_name))
  if (is.na(celeb_name) || celeb_name == "") return(NA_character_)
  
  Sys.sleep(0.25)
  
  direct_slug = utils::URLencode(stringr::str_replace_all(celeb_name, " ", "_"), reserved = TRUE)
  direct_url  = paste0("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/", direct_slug)
  
  bday = tryCatch({
    pg = read_wiki(direct_url)
    pg |> rvest::html_element("span.bday") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
  
  if (!is.na(bday) && bday != "") return(bday)
  
  tryCatch({
    api_res = httr::GET(
      "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php",
      query = list(action = "opensearch", search = celeb_name, limit = 1, format = "json"),
      ua
    )
    parsed = jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(api_res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    if (length(parsed) >= 4 && length(parsed[[4]]) > 0) {
      alt_url = parsed[[4]][1]
      if (alt_url != direct_url) {
        pg2 = read_wiki(alt_url)
        bday2 = pg2 |> rvest::html_element("span.bday") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
        if (!is.na(bday2) && bday2 != "") return(bday2)
      }
    }
    return(NA_character_)
  }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
}

unique_celebs = unique(na.omit(dwts_casts_raw$Celebrity))
bday_strings = mapply(
  get_birth_date_by_name,
  celeb_name = unique_celebs,
  idx        = seq_along(unique_celebs),
  total      = length(unique_celebs),
  USE.NAMES  = FALSE
)

bday_lookup = tibble::tibble(
  Celebrity  = unique_celebs,
  birth_date = lubridate::ymd(bday_strings)
)

dwts_casts = dwts_casts_raw |>
  dplyr::left_join(bday_lookup, by = "Celebrity") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    status_mdy  = lubridate::mdy(stringr::str_extract(
      Status,
      "(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\\s+\\d{1,2},\\s+\\d{4}"
    )),
    status_dmy  = lubridate::dmy(stringr::str_extract(
      Status,
      "\\d{1,2}\\s+(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\\s+\\d{4}"
    )),
    status_date = dplyr::coalesce(status_mdy, status_dmy)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(season) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    earliest_status = suppressWarnings(min(status_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    season_start = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(earliest_status),
      earliest_status - lubridate::days(7),
      lubridate::ymd(paste0(dplyr::first(page_year), "-09-15"))
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_on_show = as.integer(floor(as.numeric(difftime(season_start, birth_date, units = "days")) / 365.25))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Celebrity, Notability, Status, season, age_on_show)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save Both Final CSVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(dwts_casts, file.path("data", "dwts_casts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dwts_weekly, file.path("data", "dwts_weekly.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
